Here’s how you can update your contact or account details with NOBULL:

Email address: Changes to your account email are not supported. For security, your email is a core identifier. If you need a different email, please create a new account.
Subscription shipping details: Log in, select Manage Subscription, click Edit next to Shipping Information, update your address, and save.
Subscription payment details: Log in, go to Manage Subscription, click Edit next to Billing, and update or add a payment method.
Email preferences: Manage marketing emails through your preferences page or unsubscribe by replying STOP to text messages.

If you’re referring to another account detail, only the options above are currently supported.
